# PokoMatch

> Free web companion for Pokémon Pokopia: plan habitats, match compatible roommates, and track your Pokédex—including Bubbly Basin (Expansion Pass).

PokoMatch (https://pokomatch.com/) helps players of Pokémon Pokopia build habitat groups where Pokémon can live together without habitat conflicts, while maximizing shared favorites. Data stays in the browser; no account is required.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://pokomatch.com/): Overview of the habitat planner and Bubbly Basin support
- [Match Maker](https://pokomatch.com/matchmaker): Automatic and custom roommate groups (up to four), next-member suggestions, and habitat item ideas
- [Insights](https://pokomatch.com/insights): Read-only views of ideal habitats, favorites, and items in the dataset
- [Pokédex](https://pokomatch.com/pokedex): Browse Standard, Event, and Basin Pokédex entries; lock/unlock species for matching

## What it helps with

- Habitat roommate matching for Pokopia
- Planning around habitat types (Bright, Dark, Humid, Dry, Warm, Cool) and conflict rules
- Bubbly Basin Expansion Pass / Basin Pokédex companion tools
- Filtering matches to Pokémon you have unlocked

## Notes

- Unofficial fan tool; not affiliated with Nintendo, The Pokémon Company, or related rights holders
- Source: https://github.com/lukasf96/pokomatch
